title: Walk to Broadway From Your Exclusive Condo
description:
Challenge friends to a game of billiards within the exposed-brick walls of a former industrial building. This fascinating, art-filled loft is made for fun and entertaining with its ample seating, Viking fridge, cocktail bar and acres of floor space. Amazing spot only a few steps away from all the action of Printers Alley, Broadway and either one of the 3 stadiums.

The space
This is the entire 2nd floor of a 4 story building.

Guest access
You will get the access code for the gold door and then you will have to use the fob to activate the elevator for your level.
